build_padding_layer_zero: build a zero padding layer using build_padding_layer with cfg type zero and padding size
build_padding_layer_reflect: build a reflection padding layer using build_padding_layer with cfg type reflect and padding size
build_padding_layer_replicate: build a replication padding layer using build_padding_layer with cfg type replicate and padding size
register_custom_padding_module: register a custom padding module to PADDING_LAYERS registry with a unique name and module class
review_padding_layer_registry: review the PADDING_LAYERS registry to see registered zero reflect and replicate padding module types
